description: This file defines interfaces, classes, and templates for inter-process communication (IPC) within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes message serialization/deserialization, IPC channel management, and factory registration for IPC handlers.

classes.name: IMessage
classes.description: Interface for messages that can be serialized and deserialized for IPC communication.

classes.name: IIPC
classes.description: Interface representing an IPC message with label, parameters, and response.

classes.name: IIPCServer
classes.description: Interface for server-side handling of IPC procedures.

classes.name: IPCMessageType
classes.description: Template class representing a specific IPC message type with parameter and response payloads.

classes.name: IPCChannel
classes.description: Abstract class managing IPC channels, registration, and message reporting.

classes.name: IPCChannelType
classes.description: Template class extending IPCChannel, managing source, extension, and message flow with link and factory.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes an IMessage into a byte stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into an IMessage.

methods.name: Procedure
methods.description: Handles an IPC message on the server side.
